mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for an RV building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, gather your RV dimensions, your property plot map, and a list of desired utilities. Measure your vehicle length including hitches, rear bike racks, and bumpers, along with the width with slide-outs extended. Check your property layout for overhead power lines, underground utility easements, and septic tank drain fields, which dictate where a pad can be poured. Deciding in advance whether you want indoor winterization hookups, a sanitary dump drain, or secondary vehicle parking will streamline early design consultations and site layout planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure your RV with accessories and slide-outs, locate property easements and septic areas on your site plan, and determine which electrical or water hookups you require.
